_description:
Event gates and Frozen Labyrinth -> server/data/event_gates.json (roadmap Phase 7b; server: event_gate.py,
labyrinth.py).

Sources belgeler/wiki/etkinlikler/ (data compiled from darkorbitwiki, fandom and the official forum):
  gauntlet_of_plutus.json   Easy (X-1, maps 450-455, portal 235) and Normal (X-8, 410-415, portal 24): waves of 5 maps in random
                            order, 4 towers + Plutus on the boss map; one entry per day (both modes together), 5 lives, time is measured.
                            In Easy the aliens are at half strength and give half rewards (wiki: "2x weaker").
  vortex_of_terror.json     Halloween; X-4, 8 maps (227, 230-236, client "GG Trial of Terror"), portal 81; 12-hour cooldown; one of the "or"
                            waves is chosen at random on entry (the wiki does not describe the choice); no completion reward, Frightful Curcubitor
                            drops a box.
  kutular_ve_etkinlikler.json  Birthday Gate (Y6, map 57 "GG Y6", portal 15): 11 December, 3 lives, once a year.
  frozen_labyrinth.json     16 maps (430-445, ATLAS A-C entry), regions, 2019 gate table, aliens, key drop probabilities,
                            Skoll, Synk.
  permafrost_fissure.json   Permafrost Fissure (X-1, Subglacial CPU, the client's map 228): 45 waves of 10 sections in a single gate, UFO and
                            Ufonit's Proxium boxes, completion reward (Proxium Drop Booster ...). cold_wave_2014.json: The Breach (Easy and
                            Hard; 20 lives, 3 waves). devolarium_attack.json: Devolarium Attack (only while the "Preemptive Strike Force" quest
                            is active; map 223). plutus_deney.json: Plutus' Experiments (three risks, tower, alien tiers, box table,
                            progress point exchange) -> 'experiment' section (server: plutus_experiments.py).
Appearances are from the client's game.xml and lib_ships (ship type / npcId): Cote Lo 260/213, Kodkod 261/214, Aura Dun Jig 262/215,
Lac Lion 263/216, Natal Nap 264/217, Plutus 265/218, Plutus Warhead 266/219, Plutus Turret 267/220, Ufonit 21/26, Demon Drone 151
("deamon drone npc"), Frightful Curcubitor 317, Frozen Icy 103/221, Frozen Kristallin 109/222, Frozen Kristallon
154/223, Frozen Boss Kristallin 110/224, Frozen Boss Kristallon 155/225, Frozen Meteoroid 101/226, Frozen Super Meteoroid 33/227,
Skoll 127/280, Synk 271/228 (demaNeR from gates.json). Box types are the client's lib_collectables (GOP_EASY_BOX, GOP_NORMAL_BOX, DEMON_BOX,
FRIGHTFUL_CURCUBITOR_BOSS_BOX, FROZEN_LABYRINTH_BOX …).
Adaptations (since the source gives none) are in the "_adaptation" notes: Demon Drone and Frightful Curcubitor values, Warhead damage, box
counts and probabilities, labyrinth population, Synk and Skoll intervals, speeds.

vortex.name: Trial of Terrors
vortex._dark: the maps are dark, only the direction the ship is facing is lit (the user's observation in the real game; the client's VisualModifier FLASHLIGHT 62 / FlashLightEffect; not written in public sources)
vortex._source: wiki vortex-of-terrors-gate (8 maps, 90 Curcubitors; a 2023 player comment also says 90), official forum FAQ 2020-2026 (X-4, 12-hour cooldown, no completion reward, in the gate Curcubitor only drops Treat); lives 5 from the old version (the FAQ does not give a life count)
vortex._adaptation: one of the "or" waves at random; Box A from Uber, Box B from Boss (25%), Box C from Curcubitor (15%) aliens (the source does not say which one drops it); Frightful Curcubitor uses a sticky bomb and summons Curcubitor

invasion.name: Compromising Invasion
invasion._source: darkorbitwiki compromising-invasion: 8 main waves and group values, 100,000 HP; the reward is that of the 100th elite quest
invasion._adaptation: the gate is at level 22 on X-1; the reward is given by 122106 (100th elite quest); if the gate is finished while the quest is active, the quest is completed (the gate has no reward of its own: the same two designs would be given a second time; there is also no "once": a pilot who finished the gate without taking the quest would be stuck on 122106 forever)

experiment._adaptation: Plutus’ Experiments is not in the calendar: it runs in the Gauntlet of Plutus window (if the calendar has plutus_deney, that one); the beacon tower spawns on X-1 / X-5 / 4-4, not on maps 401-404; the damage thresholds that determine which alien appears, the Overlord/Devourer total HP and the extra chances (chance 10%, small 2%, rare 0.5%) have no source; PvE instead of High Risk PvP; since the progress window is dead, the reward of the point thresholds is given automatically when reached, there is no reset (15,000 uridium)
